mainDressCode.title: Dress Code
mainDressCode.description: We kindly request our guests to dress in elegant, formal attire to celebrate our special day.

sections.title: PARENTS AND PRINCIPAL SPONSORS
sections.description: We would love to see our parents and principal sponsors in barong and filipiniana.

sections.title: BEST MAN
sections.description: We would love to see our best man in black or blue coat with pink tie.

sections.title: GROOMSMEN
sections.description: We would love to see our groomsmen in black vest and red bowtie.

sections.title:
MAID OF HONOR AND
FLOWER GIRLS
sections.description: We would love to see our maid of honor and flower girls in formal dresses with a touch of pink.

sections.title: BRIDESMAIDS
sections.description: We would love to see our bridesmaids in burgundy red dress of their choice.

sections.title: GUEST ATTENDEES
sections.description: We would love to see our guests in semi-formal attire in burgundy red, or black to match our celebration theme.
